capabilities: translate selected text in a modal
configure multiple translation services (Youdao, Microsoft, Baidu)
bind a hotkey to the translate command
extras: README asks for donations ('give me some coffee money!'). Settings must be filled in for at least one of the three supported services before translation works.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up translations of selected text without leaving the editor.

requires.name: translation service credentials (Youdao, Microsoft, or Baidu)

summary: Translation plugin that translates selected or entered text through a modal using Youdao, Microsoft, or Baidu services.
